g.aria-label: Penalty for Dropping Half the Dataset (1 of 2 Equal Modes)
Zero density q(x) = 0 on a real mode incurs infinite penalty
Doubling density on one mode (q = 2p) costs only log 2 nats
2 KL(m ‖ p) ≈ 0.262 nats · JS(p, q) ≈ 0.216 nats
Costs ~1/4 nat; on covered mode D*(x) = −log 2 has ∇D* = 0
Zero local restoring force: constant D*(x) = −log 2 gives no pull to missing mode
